scope: Corollary 10.2 (Uniform local complements at Mori endpoints) of the manuscript “Termination for projective log canonical fourfolds with rational boundary” (preprints/Termination-for-projective-log-canonical-fourfolds-with-rational-boundary-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 056 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8ac06a1f5c9a11c5), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 41. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix a real number ϵ > 0 and a finite set I ⊂ [0, 1] ∩ Q. There is a positive integer M = M(4, ϵ, I) with the following property. Let (X, B) be a projective ϵ-lc fourfold pair over C with coefficients in I and with KX + B not pseudo- effective. Every maximal program of Definition 1.1 ends at a Mori contraction h : (Y, BY ) → S. For every closed s ∈ S, there is an effective Q-divisor B+ Y ≥ BY such that, on the inverse image of some neighbourhood of s, the pair (Y, B+ Y ) is klt and M(KY + B+ Y ) is Cartier and linearly trivial.
